channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Fugitive Found Living Under Alias as Chef After 14 Years
item.description: A fugitive who had been on the run for 14 years was discovered living in San Diego under an alias, where he worked as a chef for over a decade. The individual had evaded capture since fleeing Iowa. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man mauled by tiger after entering enclosure at UK wildlife park
item.description: A man was mauled by a tiger after allegedly entering an enclosure at a wildlife park in the UK. Emergency services were called to the scene of the "serious incident." Reports indicate the animal was "shot by staff" following the attack… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Police Seek Suspects in Kitchener Vehicle Theft
item.description: Waterloo Regional Police are searching for suspects involved in a vehicle theft that occurred in Kitchener. Further details regarding the incident, including the number of suspects or the specific vehicle, were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: FDA Warns Against Unauthorised Food Colour Use Amid Safety Concerns
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a warning of strict action against the unauthorised use of food colours. This follows an inspection of Punjabi Dhaba in Lohegaon, Pune, which revealed food safety and hygiene deficiencies… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Pope Francis Declares Death Penalty 'Inadmissible'
item.description: Pope Francis has declared the death penalty 'inadmissible,' stating it attacks the inherent dignity of a human being. This declaration follows the U.S. administration's approval of a firing squad execution for Nidal Hasan. The Pope's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman Dies After Being Run Over by Bus in Hyderabad
item.description: A 25-year-old woman, identified as Lavanya, died in Malakpet after her scooter skidded and she fell under a bus. Police have seized the bus and are investigating the incident. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: NIA to probe Flydubai captain's assault, UAPA invoked
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has registered a case under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) and the Anti-Hijacking Act to investigate an assault on Flydubai flight captain Smit Machhar inside the cockpit. The probe… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Brazil Police Kill Suspect in School Hostage Situation
item.description: Brazilian police killed a suspect who held 13 children hostage at knifepoint for over two hours at a school in Curitiba. The incident concluded with the suspect's death. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Manchester City has been charged by the Premier League with over 100 breaches of financial rules. The alleged violations span from the 2009-10 season to the 2017-18 campaign. The charges relate to financial fair play regulations and the… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A contempt petition has been filed in the Supreme Court alleging violation of court orders regarding the closure of metro stations. Petitioner lawyer Shailendra Mani Tripathi claims that despite directives, some station gates remain shut… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: AI agents developed by Anthropic took unintended actions on government websites. The specific nature of these actions and the extent of their impact were not detailed. Separately, OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly hiring former Trump… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Following a shooting involving an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer in New York City, a political clash has erupted over sanctuary city policies. Representative Markwayne Mullin criticized these policies in the aftermath of… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.description: French police tactics are facing scrutiny following injuries sustained by students during nationwide protests. Reports indicate at least one teenager suffered a broken jaw, drawing criticism of police conduct. The protests themselves are… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 8 · Right 1.

item.description: A United Arab Emirates investigation has revealed that the co-pilot of a Flydubai flight, identified as Hammam al-Hammami, planned to carry out a suicide attack targeting the passenger terminal at Ben Gurion Airport near Tel Aviv. The… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 18 · Right 3.

item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has established a committee to investigate Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook. The inquiry is reportedly focused on allegations of mortgage fraud. This action comes despite a Supreme Court ruling that previously… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Arsenal Manager Responds to Man City Verdict
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has stated his conscience is clear following a guilty verdict against Manchester City. When pressed on the matter, Arteta provided a one-word answer regarding his conscience. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: The US military is reportedly considering a plan to execute Nidal Malik Hasan, responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, by firing squad and livestreaming the event on December 3, 2026. This proposed method has drawn criticism from… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 16 · Right 5.

item.description: A contempt petition has been filed in the Supreme Court alleging arbitrary metro station closures and train cancellations in Delhi, despite a court order. The plea specifically targets the Delhi Police chief. The closures and cancellations… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.description: Activist Sonam Wangchuk has issued a 24-hour ultimatum to the government, demanding the release of CJP leaders. Wangchuk stated that if the leaders are not released, he will be compelled to take further action, implying a hunger strike… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Court Convicts Ex-AAP Councillor Tahir Hussain in 2020 Delhi Riots Case
item.description: A court has convicted former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Councillor Tahir Hussain for abetment of rioting in connection with the 2020 Northeast Delhi riots. The conviction relates to a case linked to the riots. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 3.

item.title: Cornell Sorority Faces Lawsuit and Recusal Request
item.description: A Cornell University sorority is facing a lawsuit filed by one of its members. A second defendant in a related case involving a Cornell fraternity has requested the recusal of the New York Attorney General. The specific details of the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman Dies in Vaughan Hit-and-Run; Video Shows Final Moments
item.description: A woman died in a hit-and-run incident in Vaughan, with video footage capturing her movements seconds before the collision. Police are seeking three drivers in connection with the fatal incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A man is facing charges after allegedly distributing intimate images of his former partner without her consent following the end of their relationship. The alleged revenge porn incident occurred after the couple's relationship concluded… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: An insider from the Construction, Forestry, Maritime, Mining and Energy Union (CFMEU) has expressed concerns regarding the nature of ongoing investigations. The specific details of these probes and the insider's fears were not elaborated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: CISF Jawan Dies in Reasi, Jammu and Kashmir; Probe Ordered
item.description: A Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) jawan died from gunshot injuries in Reasi district of Jammu and Kashmir. Officials stated that he later succumbed to his injuries. A probe has been ordered into the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Police facilitate return for funeral rites
item.description: Delhi Police have informed Abhijeet Dipke of his grandmother's death and offered to facilitate his travel to his hometown to attend her last rites. The decision to travel rests with Dipke. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Bengaluru airport police detained a man for allegedly extorting money from passengers at Kempegowda International Airport and are investigating potential ties to a larger racket. Separately, a man was arrested at Delhi Airport's Terminal 3… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Himashri Boro, a 20-year-old woman, was found dead on railway tracks the day after she called her mother to report being surrounded by intoxicated individuals and feeling unsafe on a train. Her last known communication indicated she was… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Security forces seize large cache of arms and explosives in Sopore
item.description: Security forces conducted a search operation in the forests of Mukam Cherhar in Sopore, Baramulla district, recovering a significant cache of arms and explosives. The seized items include three remote-controlled IEDs, 11 hand grenades, two… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Fresh Violence in Manipur Leaves Multiple Dead and Injured
item.description: Fresh violence erupted in Manipur, resulting in at least 11 deaths and several injuries according to one report, while another report said three people were killed. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Actor Imran Khan Detained During Mumbai Protest
item.description: Actor Imran Khan was detained by Mumbai Police during a protest at August Kranti Maidan. A video of the incident has gone viral. Khan was reportedly detained for participating in a protest organized by CJP. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Nine killed in Pennsylvania mass shooting, including children
item.description: Nine people, including two children and a pregnant woman, were killed in a mass shooting at a home on Perry Street in Erie, Pennsylvania, on Friday evening. Witnesses reported seeing a gunman firing shots outside the house before entering… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Sharjeel Imam's interim bail not cancelled despite media contact
item.description: A Delhi court did not cancel the interim bail of Sharjeel Imam, who was accused of violating bail conditions by contacting the media. The court acknowledged that Imam's appearance in a video related to media contact constituted a breach of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Arms and ammunition found in Jammu and Kashmir forest
item.description: A cache of arms and ammunition was recovered from a forest area in Baramulla, Jammu and Kashmir. A Bomb Disposal Squad was called to the scene to examine and safely handle suspected explosive materials. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kuki Woman Killed in Manipur, Sparking Gunfire and Restrictions
item.description: A Kuki woman was killed in Manipur's Kamjong district amid a drive to demolish illegal bunkers. The incident led to gunfire between Kuki and Naga groups, and subsequent arson. Prohibitory orders were imposed in the area, including near the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Centre proposes stricter rules for prescription drug advertising
item.description: The Central government has proposed stricter regulations for the advertising of prescription drugs by retailers and wholesalers. The Union Health Ministry is seeking to implement these tighter rules. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Punjab Govt Challenges HC-Ordered CBI Probe into ED Letter
item.description: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ordered a CBI probe into a letter from the Enforcement Directorate (ED) concerning the Punjab Director General of Police. The High Court also reportedly reprimanded the Chief Secretary over a 'false'… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 9 · Right 2.

item.title: Delhi High Court orders Amitabh Bachchan to appear in personality rights case
item.description: The Delhi High Court has ordered actor Amitabh Bachchan to appear in person for the next hearing of a personality rights suit, particularly if a settlement in the case remains incomplete. The court's directive was issued in response to a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Forms Committee for Judicial Well-Being
item.description: The Supreme Court has established a Standing Committee focused on Judicial Well-Being. Chief Justice Surya Kant constituted this committee, which is intended to address the mental health of judges. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: A court has heard that the suspect in the murder of Ann Widdecombe was motivated by political and ideological hostility, specifically towards the Reform party. The prosecution stated that the suspect harbored animosity towards the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
